quests.title: Ann, Mary-Ann, and Marionette

dialogue.t: To be honest, I'm still in shock.
You know, back then, both Alain and I thought you'd already left this world.
Hmm... If we had woken up earlier, maybe we could have visited you and Alain. But, I suppose that's fate.
Ms. Mary-Ann...
Fate works in mysterious ways. Who would have thought that Ann and I would see a film poster featuring your portrait during our travels?
So that's what made you think to contact me?
Precisely!
Ah... The aroma of coffee. It really takes me back... Hehe, thank you for inviting us to your tea party, Miss Sandrone.
Your garden is so elegantly arranged. It's perfect for a lady of such grace.
This is the home Alain and I once shared. I feel it's only right that I maintain its beauty.
See? You're already so much better at this than my brother.
Alain never even decorated his room. He couldn't deal with pretty things.
That's right, and Rene was no different. Jakob and I were the only ones who could properly spruce up a room — and prepare a tea party.
So he was like that even when he was little? I always thought it was due to his age...
He was always that way. He may have been book smart, but he was a bit of a klutz in other ways.
Maybe that's why he was the only one of us who chose painful reality over the illusion of a sweet dream.
Huh. I don't think he regretted that choice.
No, because that was his wish as a hero.
The regret is ours. His wish should never have stood alone.
What about you, Miss Sandrone? Is there something you wish for?
Alain once asked me that exact same question.
Hmm? So he asked you that, too?
My brother must have matured a lot. He never would have asked something like that when I knew him.
"Wish" is such a hollow word. Can you ever have whatever you want? Hah, if that were the case, there would be no bad in the world.
I'm doing what I want to do, what I believe to be right. I don't know if this counts as a wish, but it makes me happy.
Hmm, now that is a wonderful thing. I envy you.
Then do you... resent Alain? Because he created you... in Mary-Ann's image.
Never. He always made it clear that I'm my own person — unique and distinct — and that I should choose my own life. So that's exactly what I did.
Haha, whether it's stories or food, as long as you're happy with your choices, then they're the right choices for you, Sandrone.
Exactly. So now, let's just quietly enjoy the food you've so carefully prepared for us.
Life is best when all is peaceful and calm...

dialogue.sit: (Let's sit like this for a little while longer.)
I think it's time I started clearing up.

dialogue.t: Is that the time? Haha. We should get together more often, Miss Sandrone.

quests.description: Go to the hidden dwelling, place your tea table, and have Sandrone take a seat. Then, prepare to enjoy some tea with the guests…
